sourceRefs.locator: Article 743, discussion around Figure 7, imperial panels at San Vitale. Opposing positions of the figures, plate, chalice, consecration by Maximian in 547 and limits of identification by inscription.
Theodora and Justinian panels, particularly embroidered Three Magi along the hem, purple garments, ceremonial vessels and retinues.
